description:
HushPinterest v0.0.15: 59 patches for Pinterest 14.45.0, which needs Android 10 or newer. This one moves to Pinterest 14.45.0 on Morphe patcher 2.5.0 and brings 23 new patches, Custom font, Fold related pins and Like and comment history among them. Hide ads also stops the full-screen "Continue in" ad, and new switches hide pins you've already seen and paint more of Pinterest black. Validation: 1531 runtime tests passed. All 372 patch tests passed. All 59 patches applied without forcing to Pinterest 14.45.0. Needs Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. Uninstall the stock app first, then sign in with your email and a Pinterest password.

### What's new

* New `Hide pins you've already seen` switch under Feed, part of Filter feed. Pins you scroll past or open on Home stay out of your home feed after that. `Hide seen pins for` picks how long they stay out: a day, a week, a month, or forever (the newest 50,000 pins). `Hide seen pins in search` does the same for search results, and `Forget pins you've seen` lets them all show again, with a second tap to undo it. Both switches start off. (#52)
* New `Custom font` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pick a .ttf or .otf file with Font file and Pinterest's text shows in it after a restart. Picking one turns the switch on, and the file is copied into Pinterest, so it keeps working if you move or delete the original. Icons keep their own look. It starts off. (#51)
* New `Save color on other red buttons` switch under Interface, part of Hide closeup buttons. Follow, Done and Pinterest's other red buttons take the color you picked for the Save button. It starts off. (#48)
* New `Black buttons` switch under Interface, part of AMOLED black. In dark mode, Pinterest's gray buttons, like Message and Edit profile on a profile, turn pure black and keep their labels. So do the gray chips over search results, like Filter, the rows of the "Refine your search" lists between results, and your account card at the top of Pinterest's own settings. It starts off. (#48)
* The patches now target Pinterest 14.45.0, version code 14458020. APKMirror has it as a plain APK for Android 10 or newer. Older Pinterest versions are refused.
* Long-pressing the Home button in the bottom bar now opens the HushPinterest settings, the same as long-pressing the Pinterest logo. The other buttons keep what Pinterest does with a long press. (#48)
* New `Hide the refresh pill` switch under Feed, part of Keep Home feed. After you've been away, Home no longer shows the pill that offers new pins. Pull down on Home when you want them. It starts off. (#48)
* New `Hide Refine your search` switch under Feed, part of Filter feed. The "Refine your search" lists of suggested searches leave your search results, and the pins close up where they were. It starts off. (#48)
* New `Swipe down to close pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pull a pin you opened down and it closes. Pinterest built this but only turns it on for some accounts. It starts off. (#48)
* New `Full-size profile photos` patch with its own switch under Interface. Tap someone's profile photo on their profile and it opens full size. It starts off. (#48)
* New `Best video quality` patch with its own switch under Interface. Videos play at the largest size Pinterest has instead of the size it caps them at. Pinterest already does this for some accounts. It uses more data and starts off. (#48)
* New `Board order when saving` patch with its own switch under Interface. The Save to sheet lists your boards in the order your profile shows them instead of A to Z. Set your profile's boards to Custom order and drag them around, and the sheet follows. It starts off. (#48)
* With `Black bottom bar` on in dark mode, the strip at the very bottom is black from the moment Pinterest opens, instead of gray for a second until the bar shows. (#48)
* New `Pin video playback` patch with two switches under Interface. With `Don't autoplay pin videos` on, a video on a pin you open or swipe to waits for you to tap play, and a pin you go back to stays paused. With `Start pin videos muted` on, those videos start with the sound off, even after you turned the sound on for the one before. Both start off. (#48)
* New `Pinch to zoom only` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pinching a pin's picture opens it full screen, where you can zoom in and drag it around, instead of loading pins that look like it. It starts off. (#48)
* New `Like and comment history` patch with its own switch under Privacy. It keeps a list on your phone of the pins you like and the comments and replies you post, and unliking a pin takes it off. Open it from Your likes and comments under Privacy, where you can filter it to likes or comments and tap an entry to open its pin. Clear empties it. The list keeps the newest 500 and never leaves the phone. The switch starts off. (#48)
* New `Hide suggested searches` switch under Interface, part of Hide search history. On search results, the colored searches under the search bar stop showing and the row closes up behind them. The filter button stays. It starts off. (#48)
* New `Hide offline banner` switch under Interface, part of Hide pop-up banners. The bar at the top that says you're offline, then back online, stops showing. It starts off and takes effect the next time your connection drops. (#48)
* Pins you saved now stay on your own boards. Hide AI-labeled pins, Hide shopping and product pins, Hide video pins, muted words and the other feed filters leave alone any pin you own, saved yourself, or that sits on a board of yours or one you collaborate on, wherever it shows. They still filter other people's boards, and promoted pins still go everywhere. With Debug logging on, the log says which pin of yours stayed and why. (#49)
* New `Customize board tabs` patch with its switches under Interface, all off to start. On a board tab on Home, `Hide See board on board tabs` and `Hide More ideas for on board tabs` clear the picture at the top so only the board name is left, and `Board name position` moves the name to the top left, top center, middle, bottom center or bottom right. (#42)
* `Choose board tab covers`, also part of Customize board tabs, stops that picture changing. Turn it on and long-press the picture to keep the one showing, use a pin, pick a photo from your phone or go plain black. Each board remembers its own choice, and Pinterest's choice puts it back. It starts off. (#42)
* New `Hide download toasts` switch under Interface, part of Hide save toasts. Downloading a pin no longer shows the message that it started or finished. Errors still show, and Android's own download notification stays. It starts off. (#42)
* New `Black toasts` switch under Interface, part of AMOLED black. In dark mode, Pinterest's pop-up messages, like the one after you save or download a pin, turn pure black. It starts off. (#42)
* New `Second Search tap opens the keyboard` switch under Interface, part of Hide navigation buttons. On the Search page, pressing Search in the bottom bar again puts the cursor in the search bar and opens the keyboard. It starts off. (#42)
* New `Hide Home tabs` switch under Interface, part of Hide navigation buttons. It takes the row with All and your board names off the top of Home. It starts off. (#43)
* New `Hide pin menu rows` switch under Interface, part of Filter pin menu. Pick pin menu rows lists the rows of a pin's menu, the ones HushPinterest adds included, and the ones you pick stay out of the menus you open from then on. It starts off. (#43)
* New `Blank Search page` switch under Interface, part of Hide search history. The Search page shows only the search bar, with nothing under it, and searching works as usual. It starts off. (#44)
* New `Hide pin title and description` patch with its own switch under Interface. Under a pin you open, the title and description go away and the likes and comments bar stays, along with the posted date and image size if you have those on. It starts off. (#43, #44)
* New `Hide pin author` patch with its own switch under Interface. It takes the creator's whole row, picture and name included, out from under a pin you open. It starts off. (#44)
* New `Show image size` patch with its own switch under Interface. A picture's width and height show under it when you open a pin, next to the posted date if that's on. The numbers come from the largest copy Pinterest sends the app, so they can be smaller than the original upload. Videos show nothing. It starts off. (#43, #44)
* New `Hide blue highlight ring` patch with its own switch under Interface. It stops the thick blue ring Pinterest draws over buttons like Save when it wants to point out a feature. It starts off. (#42)
* New `Hide visual search thumbnails` patch with its own switch under Interface. The lens button on a pin's picture stays plain instead of showing a little stack of cropped pictures. It starts off. (#42)
* New `Fold related pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. An arrow sits under a pin you open, and related pins don't load until you tap it. Tap again and they fold away. Your last choice carries over to other pins and restarts, and Hide related pins wins if both are on. It starts off. (#46)
* Download pin now looks for an idea pin's video on its pages and in their video blocks, where Pinterest keeps it, before saying the pin has no MP4. (#45)
* Hide ads now also takes sponsored boards out of the Explore featured boards row in Search. Boards Pinterest picks itself stay.
* Hide Home suggestions now also matches two row types from a Debug report of a Home showing "Inspired by your interests" and "More ideas for your board". (#30)
* Original-quality images now reaches the picture pages of idea pins. Each page picks its own picture from its own list, so the switch never got to them before. A picture too big for Android to draw stays at Pinterest's size. Pinterest sometimes lists an original under the wrong file type and its image server refuses it, which left a grey box. The app now tries the other types, then a large copy.
* Report a problem now opens your browser even when GitHub's app is installed. The app took the link, showed its own template list and lost everything the form had filled in.
* `Black menus and sheets` now also covers the drawer that slides up from the arrow under a pin, along with the fade above its buttons. (#21)
* Hide shopping and product pins now takes the Shop the look section out from under a pin you open, the title and its row of products both. Pinterest builds that section from the pin itself instead of a feed story, so the switch used to miss it. The pin's Visit button stays, and Export report lists the part as `Shop the look under pins`. (#6)
* New `Custom splash logo` patch with its own switch under Interface. On Android 13 and newer, the screen you see while Pinterest starts shows a logo you pick instead of Pinterest's. Pick a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture in the patch's Logo option when you patch, or leave it empty for HushPinterest's logo. All of the picture shows, centered in a circle, so a square one with a clear background looks best. It starts off, and the logo shows from the next start after you turn it on. (#41)
* New `Custom save sound` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pick a sound file with Pick a save sound and it plays when you save a pin, instead of Pinterest's chime. Picking one turns the switch on, and the row can take you back to Pinterest's sound any time. If the file goes missing, Pinterest's chime plays. (#41)
* New `Hide related pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. It leaves the grid of more pins out from under a pin you open, so Pinterest never loads it. The pin, its comments and its buttons stay. It starts off, and the change shows on the next pin you open. (#41)
* New `Hide creator name on pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. Under a pin you open, the creator's name and badge go away while their picture stays, and tapping the picture still opens their profile. It starts off. (#41)
* New `Hide pop-up banners` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pinterest sometimes slides a banner up over Home, like "Shop recommended merchants". With the switch on, HushPinterest closes it through the banner's own X as soon as Pinterest shows it, so Pinterest counts it as dismissed and that banner doesn't come back. A banner that's already open when you turn the switch on stays until you close it. The switch starts off, and with it off or HushPinterest paused, Pinterest shows its banners as before.
* The patches are now built on Morphe patcher 2.5.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer to apply them. Desktop patching needs morphe-desktop 2.3.0.
* New `Black Save to sheet` switch under Interface, part of AMOLED black. In dark mode the sheet that lists your boards when you save a pin turns pure black, part way up and all the way up, along with the strip under it. The red Create new board button keeps its color. It starts off. (#31)
* New `Hide suggested boards` patch with its own switch under Interface. It takes the board Pinterest suggests under your own boards out of the Save to sheet. Your boards and Profile stay. It starts off. (#32)
* New `Expand board list` patch with its own switch under Interface. The Save to sheet opens all the way up, so you see more of your boards without dragging it first. It starts off. (#33)
* Hide ads now goes after the full-screen ad with a "Continue in" countdown that Pinterest started showing in late October when you tap a pin. With the switch on, Pinterest hears that its full-screen ads are switched off. Turn Hide ads off or pause HushPinterest and Pinterest decides for itself again. Export report lists the part as `full-screen ads when opening a pin`.
* Spoof signature for Google sign-in now hands microG-RE Pinterest's own package name, `com.pinterest`, to send Google along with Pinterest's signature. Before, a copy made with Change package name went to Google under its new package name with Pinterest's signature, a pair Google doesn't know. It stays `com.pinterest` whatever the copy is called, and Export report has a new `spoof_package` line that says whether your build carries it. (#28)
* Email and password sign-in works on a copy made with Change package name. Pinterest's sign-in runs a reCAPTCHA check that only accepts the `com.pinterest` package, and the copy sent its own, so every email sign-in there ended in "Something went wrong". The copy now tells reCAPTCHA it's `com.pinterest`. (#28)
* With Debug logging and Hide Home suggestions both on, Export report now says what each page of your feed kept. A row of ideas shows its story type. Every other kind of item gets its field names listed once in a section of their own, which stays through Clear diagnostic data. It never includes a pin title or any other text. If a suggestion row still shows on your Home, a report like that says what the row is. (#30)
* Hide Home suggestions now also takes out the "More ideas for your board" row that sits over your own boards on Home's board tab. (#30)
* New `Hide Send with an app in the long-press menu` switch under Pin actions. It takes the button that sends a pin straight to WhatsApp, or whichever app you last shared with, out of a grid pin's long-press menu. Send still lists every app. It starts off. (#35)
* The red Save button under a pin you open no longer splits its label over two lines. That happened with a long translation, Romanian's for one, on a pin with lots of likes and comments. With Hide closeup buttons in your build, the label goes back on one line. The button's padding shrinks first, then the text gets a little smaller if it has to. The button is one line tall too, instead of keeping the height the two lines took. A pin with more room shows Pinterest's button as it was. (#38)
* New `Hide saved pins in search and More to explore` switch under Feed, part of Filter feed. It takes pins you've saved or own out of search results and out of the More to explore pins under a pin you open. Your boards still show them. `Hide pins you've already saved` stays about your home feed. It starts off. (#34)
* New `Back leaves Home right away` switch under Feed, part of Keep Home feed. Once you've scrolled down Home, Pinterest's Back jumps to the top and loads new pins, and only a second Back leaves. With the switch on, the first Back leaves Pinterest the way it does at the top of the feed. It works with Keep Home feed on or off, and it starts off. (#36)
* New `Long-press view` switch under Pin actions, part of Long-press download. It puts a View button after Download in a grid pin's long-press menu, the round one and the newer list. Slide onto it and let go, and the pin's full-size picture opens full screen right over the grid, without opening the pin. Pinch or double-tap to zoom, drag to look around, and Back or the X closes it. The picture isn't saved anywhere. View doesn't need Download pins on, and a video pin doesn't get it. It starts off. (#37)
* Two new switches under Interface, part of AMOLED black, both off to start. `Black menus and sheets` turns the other menus and sheets that slide up pure black in dark mode: Create, a board's Board view, sort and Options menus, Add collaborators and the rest. Their buttons and Create's tiles keep their gray. `Black board and profile buttons` does the same for the gray bar that floats over a board and the filter buttons on your profile, along with the empty cover on Edit board. A sheet with a switch of its own, like the Save to sheet or a pin's menu, still follows that one. (#39)
* In Morphe Manager's patch list, `AMOLED black` now sits in its own Theme group and `Open links in your browser` in a Links group, so the Interface group still fits on one screen with the two new patches in it.
* New `Let the screen sleep` switch under Interface. Pinterest keeps the screen on while a video is on it, playing or paused, so a pin left open with a video showing never let the phone sleep. With the switch on, the screen turns off after your phone's usual timeout. It starts off. (#47)
* `Show posted date` now shows just the date under a pin's title, without "Posted" in front, so the line takes less room. (#47)
* The last choice in a HushPinterest list dialog is no longer cut in half. A list of a few choices, like `Hide seen pins for`, `Board name position` or the download pickers, measured each row without its radio button or checkbox, so the dialog came out too short for the rows. (#52)
* The search box in HushPinterest settings now sits on every page, and it finds switches on all of them from wherever you are. Clear it or press Back and you're back on the page you were on, at the same spot.

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Paints the bottom bar pure black in dark mode, so it matches Pinterest's black pages on OLED screens. The comments sheet, a pin's menu, the Save to sheet that lists your boards, the other menus and sheets, the buttons over boards and profiles, Pinterest's pop-up messages and its gray buttons can go black too, each with its own switch. Light mode stays as it is. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Best video quality
patches.description: Plays videos at the largest size Pinterest has instead of capping them, the way Pinterest already does for some accounts. Uses more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Board order when saving
patches.description: Lists your boards in the Save to sheet in the order your profile shows them, a custom order included, instead of A to Z. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Gives the patched Pinterest its own package name and app name (HushPinterest unless you pick another), so it installs beside the Pinterest you already have instead of over it. It's a separate app with its own sign-in. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: The copy's package name. Each copy needs its own.
The name under the copy's icon, up to 30 characters.

patches.name: Custom font
patches.description: Shows Pinterest's text in a font file you pick, a .ttf or .otf. Icons keep their own look. Starts off. Pick the file with Font file in HushPinterest settings > Interface, which turns the switch on for you, then restart Pinterest.

patches.name: Custom save sound
patches.description: Plays a sound file you pick on your phone when you save a pin, in place of Pinterest's chime. Pinterest's other sounds stay. Starts off. Pick the sound with Pick a save sound in HushPinterest settings > Interface, which turns the switch on for you.

patches.name: Custom splash logo
patches.description: Shows a logo you pick on the screen you see while Pinterest starts, in place of Pinterest's, on Android 13 and newer. Pick the picture in the patch's Logo option when you patch. Leave it empty for HushPinterest's logo. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

options.description: A PNG, JPEG or WebP picture, up to 2048 pixels a side. All of it shows, centered inside a circle, so a square picture with a clear background looks best. Leave it empty for HushPinterest's logo.

patches.name: Customize board tabs
patches.description: Tidies the top of board tabs on Home. You can hide the See board button and the More ideas for line and move the board name. You can also stop the picture changing by keeping it or by choosing a pin, a photo from your phone or plain black. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Pinterest from sending usage reports, crash reports and ad-tracking data to outside companies, and turns off Google's analytics inside the app. Good if you'd rather share less. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable update nag
patches.description: Stops Pinterest's pop-ups asking you to update from the Play Store. You can still update Pinterest yourself. Good if the reminders get annoying. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Updates.

patches.name: Download board
patches.description: Adds Download board to a board's menu. It saves every pin Pinterest has loaded for that board, up to 500, and skips ones already in Download history, so you can keep a board without picking pins one at a time. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches.name: Download pins
patches.description: Adds downloads for a pin, or for several pins you select in a grid. Saves the original image or the highest-quality video Pinterest supplies to your phone. When it saves an image, Pinterest's own Download image row is hidden. Downloads go to the Download folder. Turn on Save in Pinterest's folder to keep them in Pictures/100PINT/Pins with Pinterest's own saves, or use Pick a download folder to choose any folder inside Pictures, DCIM, Download or Documents. Starts off. Copy image puts an image pin's full-size picture on the clipboard, and Share image sends it through Android's share menu. Each has its own switch, also off. Save pins you download also saves a pin you download to your profile, and Download pins you save also downloads a pin you save. Those two start off as well. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches.name: Expand board list
patches.description: Opens the Save to sheet all the way up when you save a pin, so more of your boards show without dragging it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Filter feed
patches.description: Lets you take video pins (photos and GIFs stay) and pins that mention words you mute out of your home feed, search, related pins and other people's boards, pins you've already saved out of your home feed, search and More to explore, pins you've already seen out of your home feed and search, and Pinterest's suggestion rows out of your home feed. Starts off. Set it up in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Filter pin menu
patches.description: Lets you hide Add to collage, Remix collage, Search image and Promote pin in a pin's menu, each with its own switch. Another switch takes out the rows you pick from a list, including the ones HushPinterest adds. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Fix push notifications
patches.description: Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. Google's Firebase service only signs Pinterest up when the request names Pinterest's original signature, so this sends that signature's fingerprint and changes nothing else in the request. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Fold related pins
patches.description: Puts an arrow under a pin you open. Related pins stay folded and don't load until you tap it, and tapping again folds them. Your last choice is kept. Hide related pins wins when both are on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Full-size profile photos
patches.description: Opens someone's profile photo full size when you tap it on their profile, the way Pinterest already does for some accounts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Lets Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Pick it only if microG-RE is on your phone. Without microG-RE, Google sign-in and push notifications stop working in the patched app. It brings Spoof signature for Google sign-in along. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Hide AI-labeled pins
patches.description: Removes pins that Pinterest labels as made or changed with AI from your home feed, search, related pins and other people's boards. A second switch also takes unlabeled pins whose title or description calls them AI art, or that come from an AI image site. Other AI images still show. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide Assistant
patches.description: Removes Pinterest's AI Assistant from search, boards and pins, so you don't get its buttons or its suggestion row. Regular search keeps working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide Inbox updates
patches.description: Leaves the Updates section out of your Inbox, so it doesn't load. The pin ideas Pinterest puts there go, and so do the activity updates in that section. Your messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes promoted pins from your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides panels that only hold ads. Good for a cleaner feed. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide advertising ID
patches.description: Pinterest sees an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same as if you deleted your advertising ID in Android. Pinterest also stops keeping its browser ID in Google's Block Store, so a reinstall doesn't bring the old one back. Good for keeping ads from following you. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide blue highlight ring
patches.description: Stops the thick blue ring Pinterest draws over buttons such as Save to point out a feature. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide closeup buttons
patches.description: Lets you hide the buttons on a pin you open, each with its own switch. That covers the back arrow and the visual search (lens) button that float over the picture, the like, comment, share and more buttons under it, the Remix button and the Visit site button. Another switch keeps the lens but drops its glow and the Search image label Pinterest puts on it for your first pins each day. Two more rows draw the red Save button smaller or paint it a color you pick, and another gives Pinterest's other red buttons, like Follow, that color too. Your phone's back gesture still leaves the pin, and Search image in the pin menu still works. They all start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide comments
patches.description: Collapses the comments and comment previews under pins. It doesn't change who can comment on your pins. Good for a quieter pin page. Hide comment previews, a separate switch, hides only the previews and comment photos, so the comment box and the way into all comments stay. Another switch hides the suggested replies next to the comment box. All three start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide creator name on pins
patches.description: Hides the creator's name and badge under a pin you open and keeps their picture, which still opens their profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide header buttons
patches.description: Hides the small icon buttons at the end of the top bar. Back buttons, text buttons and account controls stay. Good for a cleaner top bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches.description: Lets you hide the Create, Notifications and Search buttons in the bottom bar, each with its own switch. The Create and Notifications switches also cover those buttons at the top of Home. Home and Profile stay. Two more switches take the row of tabs off the top of Home and make a second press on Search open the keyboard. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide pin author
patches.description: Removes the creator's whole row, picture and name included, from under a pin you open. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide pin title and description
patches.description: Removes the title and description under a pin you open. The likes and comments bar stays, and so do the posted date and image size when they're on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide pop-up banners
patches.description: Closes pop-up banners such as "Shop recommended merchants" the way their X does, so Pinterest records that you dismissed them. A second switch hides the bar at the top that says you're offline, then back online. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide related pins
patches.description: Leaves the grid of related pins out from under a pin you open, so it doesn't load. The pin, its comments and its buttons stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide save toasts
patches.description: Stops the pop-up Pinterest shows after you save a pin, such as the Saved to your board message or a suggestion to follow the creator. The pin is still saved. A second switch does the same for the messages after a download. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide search history
patches.description: Hides your recent searches on the search screen of this phone. It doesn't delete your account's search history. A second switch leaves only the search bar on the Search page, and a third hides the colored suggested searches under the search bar on search results. All start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide shopping and product pins
patches.description: Hides shoppable pins, shopping stories, featured boards and the Shop the look section under a pin. Good if you want to browse ideas, not products. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide suggested boards
patches.description: Hides the board Pinterest suggests under your own boards when you save a pin, such as one it offers to make for you. Your boards and Profile stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide survey prompts
patches.description: Turns down Pinterest's "Got a minute?" survey invite before it pops up, the same way tapping Maybe later does, so the same survey doesn't come back. Advertiser-sponsored polls don't pop up either. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide topic suggestions
patches.description: Hides the Ideas you might love row of topic bubbles under pins, without leaving a gap. Comments and related pins stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide visual search thumbnails
patches.description: Keeps a pin's lens button plain, without the little stack of cropped pictures Pinterest puts on it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: HushPinterest settings
patches.description: Adds a HushPinterest page to Pinterest where you turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it from Pinterest's settings, or by long-pressing the Pinterest logo at the top of your home feed, the Home button in the bottom bar or Pinterest's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Keep Home feed
patches.description: Keeps your Home feed where you left it when you come back to Pinterest or to the Home tab, instead of loading new pins on its own. Pull down to refresh whenever you want new pins. A second switch lets Back leave Pinterest from a scrolled-down Home without jumping to the top first, and a third hides the pill that offers new pins after you've been away. All start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Let the screen sleep
patches.description: Lets the screen turn off after your phone's usual timeout while a pin is open. Pinterest keeps it on while a video is on the screen, playing or not. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Like and comment history
patches.description: Keeps a list on your phone of the pins you like and the comments and replies you post. Find it under Your likes and comments in HushPinterest settings > Privacy, where you can show only likes or only comments and tap one to open its pin. Unliking a pin takes it off the list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Long-press download
patches.description: Adds a Download button to the menu you get when you long-press a pin in a grid, the round one and the newer list, so you can save a pin without opening it. Needs Download pins on too. Four more switches take Pinterest's Save, Send, Search image or Send with an app button out of that menu, and another adds View, which shows the pin's picture full screen. All start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches.name: No screenshot share menu
patches.description: Stops Pinterest from popping up sharing suggestions after you take a screenshot. Screenshots still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Open links in your browser
patches.description: Opens a pin's Visit link and profile websites in your web browser. Pinterest links and sign-in work as before. Good if you prefer your own browser. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Links.

patches.name: Original-quality images
patches.description: Loads the original image for each pin and in collages, instead of the large size. Pictures look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Pin video playback
patches.description: Lets a video on a pin you open or swipe to wait for you to tap play, and start with the sound off. Two switches, both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Pinch to zoom only
patches.description: Pinching a pin's picture opens it full screen to zoom and drag, instead of loading pins that look like it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Quiet email reminders
patches.description: Dismisses the optional reminder to confirm your email. Account checks and sign-in still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Remove ad tracking permissions
patches.description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Pinterest, so it can't use them. Google Play services then answers with zeros. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Show image size
patches.description: Shows a picture's width and height under it when you open a pin, beside the posted date when that's on. It reads the largest copy Pinterest sends the app, which can be smaller than the original upload. Videos show nothing. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Show posted date
patches.description: Shows the day a pin was posted under its title when you open it. Pinterest sends that date with every pin but never shows it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in
patches.description: Helps Google sign-in work in the patched app by naming Pinterest's original package and signature. It only helps with microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. Email sign-in doesn't need it. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Strip link tracking
patches.description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Pinterest. The link still goes to the same place. Its Plain pin links switch also turns short pin.it links into the pin's own pinterest.com link, so they don't show who shared them. Strip link tracking is on by default and Plain pin links starts off. Both are in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Swipe down to close pins
patches.description: Lets you close a pin you opened by pulling it down, a gesture Pinterest has built but only gives some accounts. Back and the back arrow work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: System share sheet
patches.description: Uses Android's own share menu when you share a pin link. Screenshot and download actions work as before. Good if you want your usual share targets. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

release_notes:
HushPinterest 0.0.15 has 59 patches for Pinterest 14.45.0, up from 36 in 0.0.14. It's built on Morphe patcher 2.5.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.7.0 or newer before you patch. Older Manager builds can't open this bundle. The signing key hasn't changed, and Manager should still show the signer as `46a2 ea94 21d7 b269`.

Most of this one came from your requests. You can hide pins you've already seen, pick your own font, splash logo and save sound, fold related pins away or drop them, and turn a lot more of Pinterest black in dark mode. Hide ads now also stops the full-screen ad with a "Continue in" countdown that Pinterest started showing when you open a pin. The feed filters leave the pins on your own boards alone, and email sign-in works on a copy made with Change package name.

Pinterest 14.44.0 isn't supported anymore. Get 14.45.0, patch it with the same signing key you used before and install it over your current HushPinterest. Your settings stay as they are.

## What's new

- New `Hide pins you've already seen` switch under Feed, part of Filter feed. Pins you scroll past or open on Home stay out of your home feed after that. `Hide seen pins for` picks how long they stay out: a day, a week, a month, or forever (the newest 50,000 pins). `Hide seen pins in search` does the same for search results, and `Forget pins you've seen` lets them all show again, with a second tap to undo it. Both switches start off. (#52)
- New `Custom font` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pick a .ttf or .otf file with Font file and Pinterest's text shows in it after a restart. Picking one turns the switch on, and the file is copied into Pinterest, so it keeps working if you move or delete the original. Icons keep their own look. It starts off. (#51)
- New `Save color on other red buttons` switch under Interface, part of Hide closeup buttons. Follow, Done and Pinterest's other red buttons take the color you picked for the Save button. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Black buttons` switch under Interface, part of AMOLED black. In dark mode, Pinterest's gray buttons, like Message and Edit profile on a profile, turn pure black and keep their labels. So do the gray chips over search results, like Filter, the rows of the "Refine your search" lists between results, and your account card at the top of Pinterest's own settings. It starts off. (#48)
- The patches now target Pinterest 14.45.0, version code 14458020. APKMirror has it as a plain APK for Android 10 or newer. Older Pinterest versions are refused.
- Long-pressing the Home button in the bottom bar now opens the HushPinterest settings, the same as long-pressing the Pinterest logo. The other buttons keep what Pinterest does with a long press. (#48)
- New `Hide the refresh pill` switch under Feed, part of Keep Home feed. After you've been away, Home no longer shows the pill that offers new pins. Pull down on Home when you want them. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Hide Refine your search` switch under Feed, part of Filter feed. The "Refine your search" lists of suggested searches leave your search results, and the pins close up where they were. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Swipe down to close pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pull a pin you opened down and it closes. Pinterest built this but only turns it on for some accounts. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Full-size profile photos` patch with its own switch under Interface. Tap someone's profile photo on their profile and it opens full size. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Best video quality` patch with its own switch under Interface. Videos play at the largest size Pinterest has instead of the size it caps them at. Pinterest already does this for some accounts. It uses more data and starts off. (#48)
- New `Board order when saving` patch with its own switch under Interface. The Save to sheet lists your boards in the order your profile shows them instead of A to Z. Set your profile's boards to Custom order and drag them around, and the sheet follows. It starts off. (#48)
- With `Black bottom bar` on in dark mode, the strip at the very bottom is black from the moment Pinterest opens, instead of gray for a second until the bar shows. (#48)
- New `Pin video playback` patch with two switches under Interface. With `Don't autoplay pin videos` on, a video on a pin you open or swipe to waits for you to tap play, and a pin you go back to stays paused. With `Start pin videos muted` on, those videos start with the sound off, even after you turned the sound on for the one before. Both start off. (#48)
- New `Pinch to zoom only` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pinching a pin's picture opens it full screen, where you can zoom in and drag it around, instead of loading pins that look like it. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Like and comment history` patch with its own switch under Privacy. It keeps a list on your phone of the pins you like and the comments and replies you post, and unliking a pin takes it off. Open it from Your likes and comments under Privacy, where you can filter it to likes or comments and tap an entry to open its pin. Clear empties it. The list keeps the newest 500 and never leaves the phone. The switch starts off. (#48)
- New `Hide suggested searches` switch under Interface, part of Hide search history. On search results, the colored searches under the search bar stop showing and the row closes up behind them. The filter button stays. It starts off. (#48)
- New `Hide offline banner` switch under Interface, part of Hide pop-up banners. The bar at the top that says you're offline, then back online, stops showing. It starts off and takes effect the next time your connection drops. (#48)
- Pins you saved now stay on your own boards. Hide AI-labeled pins, Hide shopping and product pins, Hide video pins, muted words and the other feed filters leave alone any pin you own, saved yourself, or that sits on a board of yours or one you collaborate on, wherever it shows. They still filter other people's boards, and promoted pins still go everywhere. With Debug logging on, the log says which pin of yours stayed and why. (#49)
- New `Customize board tabs` patch with its switches under Interface, all off to start. On a board tab on Home, `Hide See board on board tabs` and `Hide More ideas for on board tabs` clear the picture at the top so only the board name is left, and `Board name position` moves the name to the top left, top center, middle, bottom center or bottom right. (#42)
- `Choose board tab covers`, also part of Customize board tabs, stops that picture changing. Turn it on and long-press the picture to keep the one showing, use a pin, pick a photo from your phone or go plain black. Each board remembers its own choice, and Pinterest's choice puts it back. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Hide download toasts` switch under Interface, part of Hide save toasts. Downloading a pin no longer shows the message that it started or finished. Errors still show, and Android's own download notification stays. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Black toasts` switch under Interface, part of AMOLED black. In dark mode, Pinterest's pop-up messages, like the one after you save or download a pin, turn pure black. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Second Search tap opens the keyboard` switch under Interface, part of Hide navigation buttons. On the Search page, pressing Search in the bottom bar again puts the cursor in the search bar and opens the keyboard. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Hide Home tabs` switch under Interface, part of Hide navigation buttons. It takes the row with All and your board names off the top of Home. It starts off. (#43)
- New `Hide pin menu rows` switch under Interface, part of Filter pin menu. Pick pin menu rows lists the rows of a pin's menu, the ones HushPinterest adds included, and the ones you pick stay out of the menus you open from then on. It starts off. (#43)
- New `Blank Search page` switch under Interface, part of Hide search history. The Search page shows only the search bar, with nothing under it, and searching works as usual. It starts off. (#44)
- New `Hide pin title and description` patch with its own switch under Interface. Under a pin you open, the title and description go away and the likes and comments bar stays, along with the posted date and image size if you have those on. It starts off. (#43, #44)
- New `Hide pin author` patch with its own switch under Interface. It takes the creator's whole row, picture and name included, out from under a pin you open. It starts off. (#44)
- New `Show image size` patch with its own switch under Interface. A picture's width and height show under it when you open a pin, next to the posted date if that's on. The numbers come from the largest copy Pinterest sends the app, so they can be smaller than the original upload. Videos show nothing. It starts off. (#43, #44)
- New `Hide blue highlight ring` patch with its own switch under Interface. It stops the thick blue ring Pinterest draws over buttons like Save when it wants to point out a feature. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Hide visual search thumbnails` patch with its own switch under Interface. The lens button on a pin's picture stays plain instead of showing a little stack of cropped pictures. It starts off. (#42)
- New `Fold related pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. An arrow sits under a pin you open, and related pins don't load until you tap it. Tap again and they fold away. Your last choice carries over to other pins and restarts, and Hide related pins wins if both are on. It starts off. (#46)
- Download pin now looks for an idea pin's video on its pages and in their video blocks, where Pinterest keeps it, before saying the pin has no MP4. (#45)
- Hide ads now also takes sponsored boards out of the Explore featured boards row in Search. Boards Pinterest picks itself stay.
- Hide Home suggestions now also matches two row types from a Debug report of a Home showing "Inspired by your interests" and "More ideas for your board". (#30)
- Original-quality images now reaches the picture pages of idea pins. Each page picks its own picture from its own list, so the switch never got to them before. A picture too big for Android to draw stays at Pinterest's size. Pinterest sometimes lists an original under the wrong file type and its image server refuses it, which left a grey box. The app now tries the other types, then a large copy.
- Report a problem now opens your browser even when GitHub's app is installed. The app took the link, showed its own template list and lost everything the form had filled in.
- `Black menus and sheets` now also covers the drawer that slides up from the arrow under a pin, along with the fade above its buttons. (#21)
- Hide shopping and product pins now takes the Shop the look section out from under a pin you open, the title and its row of products both. Pinterest builds that section from the pin itself instead of a feed story, so the switch used to miss it. The pin's Visit button stays, and Export report lists the part as `Shop the look under pins`. (#6)
- New `Custom splash logo` patch with its own switch under Interface. On Android 13 and newer, the screen you see while Pinterest starts shows a logo you pick instead of Pinterest's. Pick a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture in the patch's Logo option when you patch, or leave it empty for HushPinterest's logo. All of the picture shows, centered in a circle, so a square one with a clear background looks best. It starts off, and the logo shows from the next start after you turn it on. (#41)
- New `Custom save sound` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pick a sound file with Pick a save sound and it plays when you save a pin, instead of Pinterest's chime. Picking one turns the switch on, and the row can take you back to Pinterest's sound any time. If the file goes missing, Pinterest's chime plays. (#41)
- New `Hide related pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. It leaves the grid of more pins out from under a pin you open, so Pinterest never loads it. The pin, its comments and its buttons stay. It starts off, and the change shows on the next pin you open. (#41)
- New `Hide creator name on pins` patch with its own switch under Interface. Under a pin you open, the creator's name and badge go away while their picture stays, and tapping the picture still opens their profile. It starts off. (#41)
- New `Hide pop-up banners` patch with its own switch under Interface. Pinterest sometimes slides a banner up over Home, like "Shop recommended merchants". With the switch on, HushPinterest closes it through the banner's own X as soon as Pinterest shows it, so Pinterest counts it as dismissed and that banner doesn't come back. A banner that's already open when you turn the switch on stays until you close it. The switch starts off, and with it off or HushPinterest paused, Pinterest shows its banners as before.
- The patches are now built on Morphe patcher 2.5.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer to apply them. Desktop patching needs morphe-desktop 2.3.0.
- New `Black Save to sheet` switch under Interface, part of AMOLED black. In dark mode the sheet that lists your boards when you save a pin turns pure black, part way up and all the way up, along with the strip under it. The red Create new board button keeps its color. It starts off. (#31)
- New `Hide suggested boards` patch with its own switch under Interface. It takes the board Pinterest suggests under your own boards out of the Save to sheet. Your boards and Profile stay. It starts off. (#32)
- New `Expand board list` patch with its own switch under Interface. The Save to sheet opens all the way up, so you see more of your boards without dragging it first. It starts off. (#33)
- Hide ads now goes after the full-screen ad with a "Continue in" countdown that Pinterest started showing in late October when you tap a pin. With the switch on, Pinterest hears that its full-screen ads are switched off. Turn Hide ads off or pause HushPinterest and Pinterest decides for itself again. Export report lists the part as `full-screen ads when opening a pin`.
- Spoof signature for Google sign-in now hands microG-RE Pinterest's own package name, `com.pinterest`, to send Google along with Pinterest's signature. Before, a copy made with Change package name went to Google under its new package name with Pinterest's signature, a pair Google doesn't know. It stays `com.pinterest` whatever the copy is called, and Export report has a new `spoof_package` line that says whether your build carries it. (#28)
- Email and password sign-in works on a copy made with Change package name. Pinterest's sign-in runs a reCAPTCHA check that only accepts the `com.pinterest` package, and the copy sent its own, so every email sign-in there ended in "Something went wrong". The copy now tells reCAPTCHA it's `com.pinterest`. (#28)
- With Debug logging and Hide Home suggestions both on, Export report now says what each page of your feed kept. A row of ideas shows its story type. Every other kind of item gets its field names listed once in a section of their own, which stays through Clear diagnostic data. It never includes a pin title or any other text. If a suggestion row still shows on your Home, a report like that says what the row is. (#30)
- Hide Home suggestions now also takes out the "More ideas for your board" row that sits over your own boards on Home's board tab. (#30)
- New `Hide Send with an app in the long-press menu` switch under Pin actions. It takes the button that sends a pin straight to WhatsApp, or whichever app you last shared with, out of a grid pin's long-press menu. Send still lists every app. It starts off. (#35)
- The red Save button under a pin you open no longer splits its label over two lines. That happened with a long translation, Romanian's for one, on a pin with lots of likes and comments. With Hide closeup buttons in your build, the label goes back on one line. The button's padding shrinks first, then the text gets a little smaller if it has to. The button is one line tall too, instead of keeping the height the two lines took. A pin with more room shows Pinterest's button as it was. (#38)
- New `Hide saved pins in search and More to explore` switch under Feed, part of Filter feed. It takes pins you've saved or own out of search results and out of the More to explore pins under a pin you open. Your boards still show them. `Hide pins you've already saved` stays about your home feed. It starts off. (#34)
- New `Back leaves Home right away` switch under Feed, part of Keep Home feed. Once you've scrolled down Home, Pinterest's Back jumps to the top and loads new pins, and only a second Back leaves. With the switch on, the first Back leaves Pinterest the way it does at the top of the feed. It works with Keep Home feed on or off, and it starts off. (#36)
- New `Long-press view` switch under Pin actions, part of Long-press download. It puts a View button after Download in a grid pin's long-press menu, the round one and the newer list. Slide onto it and let go, and the pin's full-size picture opens full screen right over the grid, without opening the pin. Pinch or double-tap to zoom, drag to look around, and Back or the X closes it. The picture isn't saved anywhere. View doesn't need Download pins on, and a video pin doesn't get it. It starts off. (#37)
- Two new switches under Interface, part of AMOLED black, both off to start. `Black menus and sheets` turns the other menus and sheets that slide up pure black in dark mode: Create, a board's Board view, sort and Options menus, Add collaborators and the rest. Their buttons and Create's tiles keep their gray. `Black board and profile buttons` does the same for the gray bar that floats over a board and the filter buttons on your profile, along with the empty cover on Edit board. A sheet with a switch of its own, like the Save to sheet or a pin's menu, still follows that one. (#39)
- In Morphe Manager's patch list, `AMOLED black` now sits in its own Theme group and `Open links in your browser` in a Links group, so the Interface group still fits on one screen with the two new patches in it.
- New `Let the screen sleep` switch under Interface. Pinterest keeps the screen on while a video is on it, playing or paused, so a pin left open with a video showing never let the phone sleep. With the switch on, the screen turns off after your phone's usual timeout. It starts off. (#47)
- `Show posted date` now shows just the date under a pin's title, without "Posted" in front, so the line takes less room. (#47)
- The last choice in a HushPinterest list dialog is no longer cut in half. A list of a few choices, like `Hide seen pins for`, `Board name position` or the download pickers, measured each row without its radio button or checkbox, so the dialog came out too short for the rows. (#52)
- The search box in HushPinterest settings now sits on every page, and it finds switches on all of them from wherever you are. Clear it or press Back and you're back on the page you were on, at the same spot.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.7.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest 14.45.0, version code `14458020`. APKMirror has it as a plain APK for Android 10 or newer, so there's nothing to merge. Pick that file in Manager.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in. If you'd rather keep the stock app, pick Change package name in Expert mode and HushPinterest installs beside it with its own sign-in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap `Forgot your password?` on Pinterest's login page to set one first. On a phone with microG-RE, pick GmsCore support when you patch and Continue with Google goes to microG-RE's sign-in instead.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

Already on HushPinterest? Update Manager, then skip steps 4 and 5. Patch 14.45.0 with the same key and install it over the one you have.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). The bundle is signed for Morphe Manager with the key in [`morphe-signing.pub`](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest/blob/main/morphe-signing.pub), and Manager should show the signer as `46a2 ea94 21d7 b269`. `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

repoDescription: HushPinterest Morphe patches for Pinterest. Hides promoted pins, AI-labeled pins, and much more.
